<Heading

  children={"Read a current log in a contest"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/contests/{id}/logs/{logId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the ordinary contest log representation, including the contest's
score and tracking values. It does not include the author's other
contest registrations. Uses the same public read access as the contest
log list. The result is current state, not the log contents at the time
of an event. A withdrawn or deleted log returns 404.
